headline: Pinto (Elettricità Futura): «Electricity bills, enough demagoguery, families are protected»
summary: Salvatore Pinto, president of Elettricità Futura, says families are protected on electricity bills. The statement comes despite ECB warnings and gas price increases that have been felt.
why: Elettricità Futura is an Italian association representing electricity producers and sellers. Electricity and gas prices feed into inflation and household and industrial energy costs.

original_headline: Pinto (Elettricità Futura): «Bollette luce, basta demagogie le famiglie sono protette»
